entities.summary: Gino Paoli was an Italian singer-songwriter. He wrote a number of songs widely regarded as classics in Italian popular music, including "Il cielo in una stanza", "Che cosa c'è", "Senza fine", "Quattro amici" and "Sapore di sale".
